paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в стойностите на перплексията при валидация върху WikiText за три езикови модела, подложени на прунинг при различни стойности на параметъра M при 70% разреденост с метода OWL. Оста X е обозначена като „M" и представлява линейна скала с диапазон от 3 до 8, като етикетите са разположени при стойности 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 и 8. Оста Y е обозначена като „Perplexity" и използва линейна скала с диапазон приблизително от 15 до 40, с етикети при 20.0, 30.0 и 40.0.

Първата линия, съответстваща на модела LLaMA1-7B, е оцветена в зелено, с кръгли маркери и плътен стил. При M=3 тя започва от стойност приблизително 27.5, след което намалява до около 25 при M=4, продължава да спада леко до приблизително 24 при M=5, достига минимум около 23.5 при M=6, след което леко нараства до около 24 при M=7 и рязко се покачва до приблизително 36 при M=8.

Втората линия, съответстваща на модела LLaMA1-13B, е оцветена в оранжево, с маркери във формата на звезда и плътен стил. Тя започва при M=3 от стойност приблизително 17.5, след което леко спада до около 17 при M=4 и M=5, остава близо до 17 при M=6, леко намалява до около 16.5 при M=7 и се покачва до приблизително 19.5 при M=8.

Третата линия, съответстваща на модела Vicuna-7B, е оцветена в синьо, с триъгълни маркери и плътен стил. При M=3 тя започва от стойност приблизително 41, спада до около 35.5 при M=4, продължава да намалява до около 34.5 при M=5, остава приблизително на 34 при M=6, след което леко нараства до около 34.5 при M=7 и рязко се покачва до приблизително 39 при M=8. Легендата е разположена в дясната част на графиката и указва съответствието между цветовете и моделите.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure displays the WikiText validation perplexity of three large language models pruned at 70% sparsity using OWL across various values of M. The x-axis is labeled "M" with a linear scale ranging from 3 to 8, with tick marks at integer intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" with a linear scale ranging approximately from 15.0 to 40.0, with tick marks at intervals of 5.0 (at 20.0, 25.0, 30.0, 35.0, and 40.0). Three lines are shown. The green line with circular markers represents LLaMA1-7B; it starts at approximately 27.5 at M=3, decreases to roughly 24.5 at M=5, then rises slightly to about 25.0 at M=6, and increases further to approximately 36.0 at M=8. The orange line with star-shaped markers represents LLaMA1-13B; it begins at approximately 17.5 at M=3, decreases slightly to around 16.0 at M=4, remains relatively stable near 16.0 through M=5, M=6, and M=7, then rises to approximately 19.5 at M=8. The blue line with triangular markers represents Vicuna-7B; it starts at approximately 41.0 at M=3, decreases to about 35.0 at M=4, continues to decrease to roughly 34.0 at M=5, stays near 34.0 at M=6, then increases to approximately 36.0 at M=7 and further to about 39.0 at M=8. All three lines are drawn as solid lines and generally exhibit a pattern of decreasing or stable perplexity in the middle range of M values with an increase at M=8.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—pruned at 70% sparsity using OWL, as a function of the parameter M. The x-axis is labeled "M" and displays values on a linear scale ranging from 3 to 8, with tick marks at integer intervals (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8). The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" and spans approximately from 15 to 40 on a linear scale, with gridlines visible at 20.0, 30.0, and 40.0. The LLaMA1-7B line is shown in green with circular markers and a solid line style; it starts at approximately 27.5 at M=3, decreases to around 24.5 at M=5, remains relatively steady near 24 at M=6, then rises to approximately 25 at M=7 before increasing further to roughly 36 at M=8. The LLaMA1-13B line is shown in orange with star-shaped markers and a solid line; it starts at approximately 17.5 at M=3, decreases slightly to around 16.5 at M=4, remains near 16–17 through M=5, 6, and 7, and then increases to approximately 20 at M=8. The Vicuna-7B line is shown in blue with triangular markers and a solid line; it begins at approximately 41 at M=3, decreases to around 35 at M=4, continues declining to roughly 34 at M=5, stays near 34 at M=6, then increases to approximately 35 at M=7 and further to about 39 at M=8. All three lines exhibit a general pattern of initially decreasing perplexity followed by an increase at higher M values.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Validierungs-Perplexität auf dem WikiText-Datensatz für drei Sprachmodelle – LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B und Vicuna-7B –, die mit verschiedenen Werten von M bei 70 % Sparsity unter Verwendung von OWL pruned wurden. Die x-Achse ist mit „M" beschriftet und verwendet eine lineare Skala mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei den Werten 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 und 8. Die y-Achse ist mit „Perplexity" beschriftet und verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala, die einen Bereich von etwa 15 bis über 40 abdeckt, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 20, 30 und 40. Die Linie für LLaMA1-7B ist grün mit runden Markierungen und durchgezogenem Linienstil dargestellt; sie beginnt bei M=3 bei etwa 27,5, sinkt auf ein Minimum von ungefähr 24 bei M=5, steigt dann leicht auf etwa 25 bei M=7 und erreicht bei M=8 einen Wert von ungefähr 36. Die Linie für LLaMA1-13B ist orange mit sternförmigen Markierungen und durchgezogenem Linienstil dargestellt; sie beginnt bei M=3 bei etwa 17,5, verläuft relativ gleichbleibend mit Werten um 16 bis 17 zwischen M=4 und M=7 und steigt bei M=8 leicht auf etwa 19 an. Die Linie für Vicuna-7B ist blau mit dreieckigen Markierungen und durchgezogenem Linienstil dargestellt; sie beginnt bei M=3 bei etwa 41, sinkt auf ungefähr 35 bei M=4, erreicht ein Minimum von etwa 34 bei M=5 bis M=6, steigt dann bei M=7 leicht auf etwa 35 und bei M=8 auf etwa 39 an.
